issues.evidence: what_to_include_with_your_planning_application page: 'Validation requirements for Planning Applications (PDF, 0.88 Mb)' -> 1A Local Validation List 2026 FINAL PDF.pdf.

issues.detail: List date 2026-01-01 comes from PDF metadata. No adoption or publication date appears in the text; the document is headed 'Local Validation List 2025'.

Householder says '(none) ... national requirements only', but the list has a Householder Application Guide with local items. These include Heritage Statement, Parking Plan, Flood Risk Assessment, Ecological Assessment, Tree Survey, Design and Access Statement (conservation area >100 sqm), Hardstanding plan, Topographical survey and Planning Statement. Section 4 also sets specific requirements for Non-material amendments (comparison plans, explanatory statement), Discharge of conditions, Tree works (sketch map, pruning spec, arboricultural evidence), Prior approvals (Part 2 Class A/AA, Part 3) and LDC (evidence of lawful use). All of these are shown as '(none)'.
issues.evidence: 'Householder Application Guide'; Section 4 'Other application types'; item 'Evidence of Lawful Use/Development - Lawful Development Certificate for change of use'.

issues.detail: Local items not captured: Accommodation Schedule (residential); Affordable Housing Statement (major, 10+ dwellings); Agricultural Land Quality Assessment (major on BMV land); Aviation Impact Assessment (wind turbines within 30 km of East Midlands Airport, only buried in the archaeology excerpt); Bird Strike Assessment (within 13 km of EMA, likely to attract birds); Building for a Healthy Life Assessment (major residential); Character Analysis and Appraisal (new build residential); Flooding Sequential Test (FZ2/3, excluding householder and minor extensions <250 m2); Glint/Glare Assessment (major solar PV); Marketing Information (loss of B2/B8 sites); Site Waste Management Plan; Statement of Justification (structural alteration or demolition of a listed building); Structural Survey (rural conversions, listed building structural works, protected tree felling due to structural damage); Town Centre Sequential Test; Transport Statement/Assessment and Travel Plan (Leicestershire Highways Design Guide Part 2 thresholds); Visual Impact Assessment; Materials details (LBC).
issues.evidence: Section 3 Complete List of Requirements, items 19-56.

issues.detail: Several rows have a label and excerpt that do not match. 'Design and Access Statement' carries the Tree Survey excerpt; the source trigger is major development, dwellings or 100 sqm+ in a designated area, and LBC. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Full planning carries AIA/AMS/TPP tree text. 'Employment / Economic Statement' under LBC is actually the 'Materials details (LBC)' item. 'Retail impact assessment' carries the open-space trigger. 'Fire Statement' is merged with the Flooding Sequential Test. 'Photographs' gives RAL colour text, but the source trigger is demolition in a conservation area or of a listed building. Viability is merged with Visual impact, and Site levels with Planning Statement.

'Statement of Community Involvement' and 'Street scene elevations' are placed under Outline and Listed building consent from garbled text. The source SCI is for wind power with more than two turbines or hub height >15 m. Street Scene is for new build residential, except outline with access only. Neither is an LBC requirement.
issues.evidence: Item 47 SCI: wind power >2 turbines or hub height >15 m; item 49 Street Scene: new build residential (except outline access-only).

issues.detail: The BNG excerpt is a fragment and omits the local thresholds: habitat change >25 sqm, or >5 m of hedgerow/watercourse. The Open space trigger is misstated as major residential 'where there would be a loss of open space'; the source says major residential OR loss of open space/playing field.
issues.evidence: Items 17/18 Biodiversity Impact Calculation/Assessment thresholds; item 41 Open Space Assessment.

issues.detail: Most rows carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Air Quality, Noise, Lighting, Ventilation). The source's Quick Summary Guide maps items to Major/Minor/Change of use/Advert/LBC/LDC/RM/Outline/S73, and that mapping was not used.

Three tab_items are process or boilerplate text: 'Where an application is made invalid, the council will notify ... within 10 working days', 'For further guidance ... Pre-Application service is recommended' and 'To the right is a link to a pdf version of the plans shown.' The two drawing-standard lines are also near-duplicates.

summary: Grokbot used an older file URL; the council page now links '1A Local Validation List 2026 FINAL', and the workbook date comes from metadata. The extraction misses the Householder guide, the other-application-type requirements and about 17 local items, and several rows are mislabelled with excerpts from other rows.
